purpose: Separate physical receipt evidence from unresolved vendor header semantics without changing frozen capture rules
interpretation: No documented first-publication or expiry interpretation established. SDK passes raw time strings unchanged. Global clock probes do not explain the flow-header lead. Do not shift timestamps or reinterpret header to force qualification.

analysis_axes.timely_received: request starts on/after planned time; response starts no earlier than request and arrives strictly before decision deadline
analysis_axes.source_session_current: all item dates match frozen expected NY trading date
analysis_axes.source_item_times_not_future: all item times no later than response time under explicit NY timezone assumption
analysis_axes.provider_header_not_future: all last_valid_time values no later than response time under same assumption; report independently
analysis_axes.original_qualified: preserve original capture receipt boolean, never overwrite

scope: No additional live flow requests, no result-based selection, no model or production changes; interpretation supplement only.
